summary: Unpinned third-party GitHub dependency source in optionalDependencies
details: package.json declares `optionalDependencies.fca-unofficial: "github:VangBanLaNhat/fca-unofficial"` with no commit SHA, no tag, and no integrity check. On `npm install`, npm fetches whatever the default branch of that third-party repository currently points at and runs any lifecycle scripts shipped in that tree on the installer's machine. The repository owner (VangBanLaNhat) is unrelated to the hridoy-ultimate publisher, so the installer runs code controlled by a third party that can be mutated at any time without a package republish. This is an off-registry, unpinned dependency source: the manifest itself is the install-time code-inclusion vector regardless of what else the package ships.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
